goal: Join necessary organic interface fragments with local native routes while preserving actual upper bearing, process widths, original contact gaps and non-overlapping physical extrusion slabs.
diagnosis: All eight target fragments have real upper bearing demand and cannot be deleted safely.
Compact generic roofs were separate from neighboring contact contours; bottom root necks did not fit a whole nominal bead in their original source footprint.
Visibility tolerance and whole-bead legality need a consistent inset; old inside-corner area alone cannot define actual upper bearing.
Connectors are planned after original layer-height modulation and must be normalized against actual printed lower slabs.
correction: Reuse the unchanged bounded visibility planner for both original Brim behavior and full-width interface connectors.
Splice only nearby compatible interface roads in the same connected region, with fixed sorting and bounded candidate searches.
Preserve actual upper centerline bearing, original legal source arcs, process width and role; check whole deposited connector beads.
Bottom connectors use a bounded root collar, actual model-slab/blocker/belt clearances and future printed-material keepouts.
Only joined interface owners receive native physical-height modulation over already printed support; reject sub-minimum new routing slabs.
Skip absent-interface planes and clip visibility-only boolean work to the bounded connector window; candidate vertices and exported instructions remain unchanged.
Clip other-road centerlines before footprint offsets using the actual replaced interval, routing reach, maximum upper bearing width and a separate native offset guard.

Preflight every obstacle before any offset; bound each road to 512 vertices and the local obstacle set to 4096. Preserve original roads on budget exhaustion instead of deleting demanded material or blocking slicing.

result.method: All selected native cases run once in three Catch2 shards with separate TEMP directories; exact case names match the native XML inventory with no missing or duplicate cases.

local_obstacle_performance.method: Bounded read-only context snapshots and COFF instruction matching located whole-layer other-road offsets. This is an indicative caller identification, not a formal stack unwind. Current complete native coverage includes the formerly prolonged sharp-tip case and a distant-complex-road/crossing-keepout regression.

material.method: Compare complete deposited components at actual physical road bottoms; verify contact gaps from actual G-code height and XY-overlapping model surface; inspect actual upper roads using retained short interfaces.
material.shift_method: Translation from first matching model plane bounds; validation input contains one model instance.

projection.method: Compare raw native roof interfaces to actual projected top contacts and precomputed organic roofs. Exact closing is independently approximated with GEOS mitre joins; the half-bead envelope is a separate conservative growth bound. Bottom landing projections retain the original transition regularization and are excluded from the roof-only growth bound.
